chose: A snip, a Clips Library frame and a some-ui.screens/1 screen (RR31) are one family: a picture of a screen of the app, with any named parts boxed. The snip record moves into @some-ui/video-render beside the screen record. It gains the two facts a screen has that it lacked: its scale, and the parts the page names (data-region), measured on the web walk; the APK's device screenshots name none. A scene shows one by one new member of the cut list's picture union, {kind: screen, of}, where of is a closed union: {from: snips, id, at} or {from: clips, clip, side, file}. resolveScreens draws it with what the renderer already has: a still of the whole screen, or, for a snip given parts, the screen-zoom composition over the snip read as a screen (snipScreen). There is no second scene kind, renderer path or screen schema.
options: one family: a screen picture whose source is a closed union of snips and clip frames, resolved to a still or a zoom, the record beside screens/1

gray: The owner asked for a snip scene (SNIPS4), for RR31's zoomed phone cards and for the showcase's clip frames. All are pictures of the app's screens. Whether they are one thing is a design reading (C820, C830), not settled by any check or earlier decision. It decides what the owner sees when an essay points at a part of a screen.
